## What changed?
Describe observable behavior, affected routes and why the change is needed.

## Verification
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Mobile and desktop preview checked (include widths/browsers)
- [ ] Keyboard navigation, focus and reduced-motion behavior checked where applicable
- [ ] Contact/chat failure and fallback paths checked if affected

## Risk / rollout
Describe any environment changes, data handling, API compatibility, external integrations and rollback plan.

## Evidence and content
Link relevant source records for any portfolio, performance, customer or security claims. Attach screenshots for UI changes.

**Release gate:** Do not merge or deploy to production without explicit repository-owner approval.
